metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enabled Dark theme. Compositional variation chains this with changing reply positioning to below-quote style (classic email style). Initial state: reply_on_top=1 and default-theme@mozilla.org, so initial state does not pass.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird menus, enable themes, and modify account identity settings.
metadata.explanation: Custom metric reads prefs.js (via vm_file getter) to check both extensions.activeThemeID and mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top. reply_on_top=0 means reply appears below the quoted text (classic style). The initial value is 1 (reply above quote). Partial credit: 0.5 per sub-goal. Agent must go to Account Settings > Composition & Addressing to change reply positioning. [Fixed: renamed metric function to use correct 32-character MD5 hash (43d8038e02a0c2b1b0f063b3804b00e6) computed from task_stem|variation_index]

scoring_breakdown.reply_below_quote: 0.5 - mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top equals 0 (reply placed below original message)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vm_file) correctly reads prefs.js after postconfig kills Thunderbird, ensuring preferences are flushed to disk before extraction.

Metric correctly accesses expected as the direct rules dict (expected.type='rule' causes framework to pass rules dict directly), using expected.get('dark_theme_id'), expected.get('reply_key'), and expected.get('reply_value') without the erroneous nested .get('rules') pattern.
Both instruction requirements are fully covered: dark mode is verified via extensions.activeThemeID, and reply positioning is verified via mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top.
Dark theme ID 'thunderbird-compact-dark@mozilla.org' is the correct internal ID for Thunderbird's built-in Dark theme, confirmed by the successful reference trajectory.
reply_on_top=0 correctly represents 'reply placed below quoted text' in Thunderbird (1 = top-posting, 0 = classic below-quote style), matching the instruction requirement.
Partial credit of 0.5 per sub-goal is semantically appropriate for this 2-requirement composed task.
Edge cases handled: None result returns 0.0, file read errors return 0.0, JSON parse failures fall back to raw string, int/string type differences for reply_value are handled via int() coercion.
